title: Whispers of the Mist
description: A fantasy Modpack with new bosses, mobs, structures, and tools. | Forge 1.20.1 |
body:
# Whispers of the Mist
Explore three new dimensions: the Everdawn, the Everbright, and the Undergarden. The End, Nether, and Overworld have also been updated with new biomes, mobs, and structures.

The combat sytem has been updated with the Better Combat mod, so weapons now slash and stab realistically. More mobs have been added, along with challenging and fun bosses for you to fight.

Create beautiful new builds with new blocks from the Abyssal Decor mod. Many more wood types have also been added. Did you ever want anchient debris bricks?

Compatible with Multiplayer, you can host worlds and message your friends with the Essential mod! 

## Use over 30 new weapons to help you fight enemies.

![Some weapons](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/699fbc7161c10cd71d872c997cd4c3a74b7b8962.png)

## And also new armor sets!

![Armor sets](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9f8db7be1caea230daf22932b627676e45c7150f.png)

There are many new things to bake and cook, like sandwitches and other delicious
things.
